According to the document, the Hansen solubility parameters of PVDF, NMP, DMF, and EG are listed in Table 1. The HSP distance (Ra) for the PVDF-EG system is 16.9 (MPa)^1/2, which is much higher than that of NMP (2.3 MPa^1/2) and DMF (2.4 MPa^1/2). This indicates that EG has a lower ability to dissolve PVDF compared to NMP and DMF.

Additionally, the FTIR spectra in Figure 2a show that the characteristic peaks of pristine PVDF at 1,399, 1,180, and 870 cm^(-1) can be clearly distinguished in the delaminated electrode, indicating that the PVDF binder was not dissolved by ethylene glycol during delamination.
